info.title: New Age AI API
info.description: Multi-tenant API for the Creator & Marketing, Business Marketing and Freelancer Growth products. All errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`.

get.description: Everything we hold about or by you, as one JSON file (right of access and portability).

post.description: Right to erasure. Needs the current password and the word DELETE.

post.description:
Send a message to the assistant. The orchestrator routes it, runs the right agent(s) with tools, validates
the output and stores the exchange. External actions come back as pending_actions awaiting approval.

schema.title: Response List Versions V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Assets  Asset Id  Versions Get

post.description:
Run a Creator studio tool. Each run gets its own conversation (titled 'Studio · …') so earlier drafts don't
leak into a new brief; the output is structured and can be saved, edited and applied.
Save chosen drafts from a content run as separate, editable library items (status: draft).

schema.title: Response Save Drafts V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Runs  Run Id  Save Drafts Post

post.description: Apply chosen parts of a brand strategy run to the client profile. Nothing is applied automatically.

schema.title: Response Import Calendar V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Runs  Run Id  Import Calendar Post
Response List Calendar V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Calendar Get

post.description:
Record that someone posted this themselves. This doesn't post anything and isn't verified against the
platform. If content is linked, it must be approved first, and it moves to 'posted'.

schema.title: Response List Campaigns V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Campaigns Get
Response List Comments V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Assets  Asset Id  Comments Get

post.description: Share chosen items with a client who has no account. The token is shown once; only its hash is kept.

schema.title: Response List Review Links V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Review Links Get
Response List Metrics V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Metrics Get

post.description:
Upload a CSV exported from a platform's insights page (or filled in by hand). All rows are checked first;
if any row is invalid, nothing is imported and every problem is listed.

schema.title: Response List Followers V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Creator Followers Get

post.description:
Run one Business tool in its own conversation (so earlier outputs don't leak into a new request). The output
is structured; saving, applying and approvals are separate, explicit steps.
Save a tool's output as an editable, versioned item, optionally inside a project.
Make a generated Intelligence Profile the business's current one (it stays editable).
Copy chosen parts of a positioning run into the profile's brand section. Nothing is applied automatically.
Turn an advertising plan into a trackable campaign (status draft). Nothing is launched.

Ask for approval to spend money (e.g. launch an ad plan) or send a message to customers. This only records
the request; it never launches, pays or sends. Approval needs a workspace admin (and an org owner/admin for
money), and even then nothing runs until an integration exists.

schema.title: Response List Work V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Business Work Get
Response List Campaigns V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Business Campaigns Get
Response List Results V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Business Results Get

post.description:
CSV with columns channel, period_start[, period_end, currency, spend, impressions, clicks, leads, customers,
revenue]. All rows are checked first; nothing is saved if any row is wrong.

get.description: Export the results report. `run_id` (a performance analysis) adds the AI-written analysis.

post.description:
Run one tool in its own conversation. Pasted job posts and saved listings go to the model as untrusted
external material, never as the user's own words, so they can't become 'experience'.

schema.title: Response List Work V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Freelancer Work Get

post.description: Save a listing the user found. It's unverified until they confirm it at the source.

The user confirms they checked the original posting: still open (verified) or closed. The app can't check
for them: there is no job-board integration.
Start an application from a saved opportunity (status 'preparing').

schema.title: Response List Applications V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Freelancer Applications Get

patch.description:
Status changes are recorded in the application's history. Marking 'applied' means the user applied
themselves: nothing is submitted from here.

schema.title: Response List Interviews V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Freelancer Interviews Get

post.description: A practice session from an interview-prep run's questions, or the user's own questions.
Type an answer; the answer coach scores it and shows a stronger version without inventing facts.

get.description: Paid plans report no counts: usage is unlimited while the plan is active.

schema.title: Response List Integrations V1 Orgs  Org Id  Integrations Get

post.description:
Stores a connection record. No provider API is called here: each integration needs a verified
connector (architecture §12) before anything uses these credentials.

Sets up the Creator division in one step: picks (solo) or creates (agency) the organisation, turns the
product on, and creates the first client workspace with its profile.

schema.title: Response List Clients V1 Creator Clients Get

get.description: What works today and what needs a platform integration. Shown in the app so nobody is misled.

post.description:
One step: picks the personal org (solo) or creates a team org, turns the product on, and creates the first
business workspace with its profile. The Intelligence Profile is generated next, on request.

schema.title: Response List Businesses V1 Business Businesses Get

get.description: Category playbooks used to tailor advice; general guidance only, the business's own facts win.

post.description: Creates the one Freelancer workspace in the personal organisation and saves the professional profile.
